tags.Analytics: Authorized live readings, consumption history and Pro reports.

operations.summary: Latest reading of an authorized meter
operations.description: Returns the most recent reading (volume, pressure, gas presence, valve state) and its freshness. Requires VIEW_CONSUMPTION on the meter. Not cached.
Consumption (difference of cumulative readings), estimated cost and simple monthly estimate per meter. Defaults to the current month. Cache-Aside with Redis (header X-Cache: HIT or MISS).
Requires USE_REPORTS on every meter and an active Pro subscription confirmed by Billing over gRPC. The report is stored in PostgreSQL and cached in Redis (header X-Cache).
